entry.name: jit.la.mult
entry.description: jit.la.mult calculates the matrix product of two input matrices (as opposed to multiplication performed by the jit.op object, which is pointwise multiplication). The input matrices must be 1-plane or 2-plane matrices of the type float32 or float64. If a 2-plane matrix is used, it is assumed that the data is from the set of complex numbers.
